newsitem.title: DUBAI: Emirates to start Dubai-Baku scheduled service.
newsitem.headline: Emirates to start Dubai-Baku scheduled service.

text.p: Dubai's Emirates airline said on Tuesday it would start a thrice-weekly scheduled service to Baku in Azerbaijain on June 2.
The Monday, Wednesday and Saturday flights will use a wide-bodied Airbus A300-600, it said in a statement.
In the third quarter of last year Emirates started operating a regular once-weekly charter flight to Baku on a leased Ilyushin 76, with capacity of about 40 tonnes.
The airline said it would try to develop the cargo business on the route, using the 12 tonne capacity on each flight. -- Dubai newsroom +9714-6071220
